projects: Build source-cited family tree with uncertainty flags
Compare duplicate-person candidates without automatic merges
Create research timeline from public records
Explain inheritance patterns without definitive kinship claims
Document consent and deletion of sensitive data

privacy_rules: Do not expose living persons' sensitive information
Require explicit permission to import private family trees or DNA
Do not scrape authenticated records or bypass access controls
Do not infer or assert paternity, ethnicity, or biological relationships from unverified matches
Provide source citations and uncertainty for every claimed relationship
Support revocation, retention limits, and deletion of stored records

integrations.postgresql: future source-cited genealogy graph and indexed record search
integrations.buddy: research assistant with reviewable evidence and user confirmation before tree edits
integrations.dna_track: optional synthetic educational examples, not automatic personal-genome linkage
